name: Match typography
description: Ranks installed or indexed fonts by visual similarity to a selected text sample so recognized text can be recreated with matching typography.

fields.name: sample_region
fields.description: Defines the image region containing the typography to analyze. The matcher derives glyph shape, weight, spacing, and other visual features from this crop.

fields.name: sample_text
fields.description: Contains the characters visible in the sample region. Known text allows the matcher to render the same characters in candidate fonts, making visual comparison more reliable.

fields.name: candidates
fields.description: Displays candidate fonts ordered by similarity score. Each result identifies a font face and reports a relative match score; the score ranks candidates and is not a probability that the original font has been identified.

font_style.description: The candidate weight and style, such as SemiBold or Italic.

match_score.description: The candidate's normalized visual-similarity score used for ranking.

fields.name: selected_font
fields.description: Stores the candidate chosen for later HTML export or text replacement.

action.name: Use selected font
action.description: Assigns the selected candidate to the active text region without modifying the image until a text replacement or export action is run.
